# Pulse 1.0.390 🚀

## 🎮 Game Hub
- 📦 Box styles: the game's picture in a PS5, PS4, PS3, Switch, Switch 2, Xbox 360, Xbox One or Xbox Series case, with the platform logo from the frame. Steam stays the default.
- 🔀 Mix: games dealt evenly across Steam, PS5, Switch and Xbox Series; the shelf is grouped by colour.
- 🖼️ The disc inside a case uses the game's wide picture, not the front cover again.
- 🔎 Cover search also tries the name without edition words (Android, Beta, Demo…).
- ⏳ "Look for covers" runs in the background, with progress.

## 🏋️ Gym
- 📄 The session is one exercise per page: swipe or use Previous / Next.
- 🎬 Each page shows the moving picture of the exercise, its muscles and its first steps.
- 🧾 Columns are named once (set, weight, reps, done).

## 🎨 Extra apps
- 🧩 Icon chooser: no top review row; a custom colour picker for icon pack pictures.
- 🌈 Material glass: optional (off by default), with three strengths and a colour picker.
- 🔁 An extra app opens its own page, not the page you left last time.

## ⚙️ Settings
- 📱 On a phone held upright: one column, the menu as tabs on top, full-width pages.

🔧 Build fix: a visibility error in the cover search code was fixed.
